correctness.rationale: Verified fourteen-facet crossing reduction independently via literal halfspace intersections rather than submitted facets code. For 35 pairs of rational-ish t and strictly generic normals, enumerated true vertices by solving supporting triples and counted crossing facets, matching both closed chamber indicator formulas exactly. At t=2 the six coordinate and eight sign facets give four crossing pairs each, hence generic section octagon; special vertex-containing normals are excluded. Haar average equals (1/pi) sum over edges of endpoint angles since Gaussian sign disagreement is angular/π; edge orbits have sizes 24+12 off t=2 and 24 at t=2. Differentiating the explicit arccos means gives strictly positive derivative for 1<t<2 and strictly negative for 2<t<3. Five sample normals were checked for each parameter including rectification; finite checks supplement rather than prove the continuous inequalities.
